text:
Elaine (PM): preflight for visibility GA. quick list: legal/residency signoff, cost estimate for default 30d window, instrumentation QA plan, canary validation criteria, and outbound export compatibility (Splunk/Datadog). who owns each?
Nadia (Security): I can take residency + legal notes. need to confirm where logs/traces are stored for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Devon (Eng): I'll own export adapters and streaming backpressure behavior. question: do we default to local aggregation or push to customer endpoint? both add complexity.
Priya (QA): QA-side I'll write probe suites for dashboard rendering, trace correlation, and cost table sanity. need sample datasets and synthetic spike generator.
Marco (Infra): infra note: retention 30d at scale increases storage by ~3x. we should provide an "economy" plan with 7d default and 30d opt-in. impacts backup/restore.
Zoe (CS): customers repeatedly ask for per-route cost trend + anomaly flags. we should include exportable CSV for billing teams.
Elaine (PM): decision needed: default retention 7d vs 30d. proposal: Hosted default 7d (opt-in 30d), Dedicated default 30d. agrees?
Nadia (Security): agree on Hosted 7d. also require encryption-at-rest + key rotation notes in docs.
Devon (Eng): for export adapters I'll prototype a streaming sink with backoff and checkpointing. sample config:
```
export:
  sinks:
    - name: datadog_sink
      type: datadog
      endpoint: https://api.datadog.com
      api_key: ${DD_KEY}
      batch_size: 500
      retry_policy: exponential
```
Devon (Eng): on backpressure, fallback policy -> buffer to local rollups then drop-detail; we should surface a warning in UI.
Priya (QA): probe plan outline: 1) dashboard load under 1k concurrent users <250ms median, 2) trace join correctness for 99% of spans, 3) cost calc cross-check against synthetic billing generator within 7% for median.
Marco (Infra): canary validation: 48-hour burn-in with traffic mirror of 5% and 3 failure-free deploys before broad beta. ops-bot: mirror job scheduled this morning.
ops-bot: mirror-job: visibility-canary-mirror started at 2024-08-02T09:12:00Z, targets: 5% traffic, duration planned: 48h.
Zoe (CS): Beta gating asks: we need 3 customers (1 enterprise, 1 midmarket, 1 startup) onboarded and confirming: dashboard usefulness, sampling transparency, and cost estimates for their top 5 routes.
Elaine (PM): GA acceptance checklist (must pass all):
- Security & residency signoff (Nadia)
- Beta customer confirmations (Zoe)
- Performance: dashboard p50 < 150ms, p95 < 450ms for standard queries
- Trace fidelity: span-join success > 98% for mirror traffic
- Cost accuracy: median error < 5% for top-10 routes
- Docs: migration guide, opt-in retention flow, export docs
- Rollback tested (Priya)

Devon (Eng): implementation detail: sampling transparency required in UI. we'll show effective sampling rate per-service + total events ingested. small mock: https://figma.redwood/visibility-sampling-ui
Nadia (Security): also require audit log for export sink config changes. admin-only.
Priya (QA): I'll automate rollback tests in CI: simulate high ingestion and verify system flips into summary-trace mode and alerts oncall.
Marco (Infra): cost calc baseline: estimate $0.60 / 100k spans stored for 7d retention on current infra. that impacts pricing doc; finance will want a model.
Zoe (CS): customer message template for beta invite drafted. includes opt-in details and list of metrics we'll provide.
Elaine (PM): risks: 1) cost overrun for Hosted if retention defaults too high, 2) data residency edge-cases for EU customers, 3) query performance when many customers enable 30d. mitigation: limit 30d to Dedicated for GA, provide quota controls and pre-aggregations.
Devon (Eng): pre-aggregation plan: nightly rollups for cost and per-route counts, real-time index for last 24h. queries beyond 24h hit rollup index.
Priya (QA): acceptance automation timeline: probes + CI rollback tests in 2 weeks. need environment with synthetic 10M spans/day.
Elaine (PM): action items: Nadia -> residency signoff doc by Tue. Devon -> export adapter POC & sampling visibility mock by Fri. Priya -> QA probe plan + synthetic dataset by Mon. Marco -> infra cost model + quota knobs by Wed. Zoe -> beta customer list + invite copy by Mon. I'll own GA checklist and release notes.
Zoe (CS): will start reaching out to customers this afternoon.
Devon (Eng): one more ask: add an "estimated cost" badge on dashboards (toggleable) to help customers see spend impact. engineering can implement as rough calc first.
Elaine (PM): good idea. include as beta feedback item. closing this thread, will compile into roadmap spreadsheet and assign JIRA tickets. :rocket:
